newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 6.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on the front page of its business section on Feb. 6:
NEW YORK - Dean Witter and Morgan Stanley's proposed $10 billion merger, a move that stunned Wall Street, would create the nation's largest securities firm as measured in terms of capitalization.
NEW YORK - David Bowie, the angular British rock star, has become the first major artist to turn himself into a bond issue -- payable over 10 years at 9.7 percent.
WASHINGTON - The convention center proposed for downtown Washington is expected to come under tough public scrutiny in a public hearing before officials charged with approving plans for the project.
WASHINGTON - After years of false starts and community bickering that dashed plans to redevelop the dilapidated incinerator site south of M Street in Georgetown, the city is trying again.
